name: Treats for Greatfather Winter
summary: During Winter Veil in Ironforge, the performer portraying Greatfather Winter asks passersby for a treat. Bring him freshly baked gingerbread cookies and ice cold milk, and he offers a festive gift with warm thanks.

sections.title: A Long Day in the Seat
sections.body: In the Commons of Ironforge, a dwarf sits by the holiday tree dressed as Greatfather Winter. The figure’s roots lie in ancient titan lore and dwarven myths of an immortal being cloaked in winter’s chill, but modern festivities rely on Smokywood Pastures. For hours, the performer hears holiday wishes from citizens and eager children.

sections.title: Baking Holiday Cheer
sections.body: After hearing requests for gifts all day, the performer grows hungry. He asks for five freshly baked gingerbread cookies and ice cold milk. The simple meal gives an exhausted festival worker a moment of relief and spreads goodwill through Ironforge.

faq.q: Where do I find Greatfather Winter in Ironforge?
faq.answer: In the Commons of Ironforge, Greatfather Winter sits beside the large holiday tree and the Smokywood Pastures display, amid festive decorations.

faq.q: How do you make Gingerbread Cookies?
faq.answer: Smokywood Pastures vendors near Greatfather Winter sell the recipe. Baking the cookies takes Cooking skill, holiday spices from the festival merchant, and small eggs gathered from wild birds.

faq.q: Where do I get Ice Cold Milk?
faq.answer: Innkeepers, food vendors, and drink sellers in major Alliance cities sell Ice Cold Milk, including the taverns across Ironforge.

faq.q: Is this Greatfather Winter the real mythic figure?
aliases: who is the guy in ironforge
faq.answer: No. A dwarf hired by Smokywood Pastures portrays the legendary titan-associated figure during Winter Veil celebrations.

faq.q: What does Greatfather Winter send you after finishing the quest?
faq.answer: After receiving the cookies and milk, Greatfather Winter gives you a Smokywood Pastures Gift Pack in thanks for your effort.

faq.q: Can Horde players complete this specific quest?
faq.answer: This offering in Ironforge is for Alliance players. Horde members have an equivalent offering that sends them to Greatfather Winter in Orgrimmar.

angles.text: As a cook, you use small eggs and holiday spices to bake gingerbread cookies.
As a dwarf, you know Greatfather Winter as an ancient legend tied to the titans and winter’s bounty. Seeing the figure snack on cookies in the Commons brings the myth down to earth.
As an Alliance traveler, you find Winter Veil festivities in Ironforge, where visitors from across the Eastern Kingdoms gather by the holiday tree in the Commons.
